title: Coraline Wool Coat / Black
body_html: The Coraline Wool Coat is a women's tailored coat woven from a recycled wool blend that combines wool, recycled wool, polyester, and polyamide. The fabric holds body and a smooth, composed face, maintaining the coat's shape through repeated wear without losing its edge. Wool's natural insulating quality works quietly in the blend, providing warmth that sits comfortably between layers as the season shifts. Polyamide and polyester reinforce the weave, keeping the silhouette steady so the coat holds its line through a full day of wear. The tailored cut sits close to the body from shoulder to hem, draping neatly over a fine knit or thin turtleneck when the temperature drops on the morning commute. In black, the Coraline carries J.LINDEBERG's Swedish design sensibility: structure and restraint, nothing added without reason.

title: Club Belt DP FOG / Black
body_html: The Club Belt DP FOG is a leather golf belt built to finish the look with intent. Cut 40 mm wide and crafted from Pro Leather, it features a golf club-shaped buckle with a rubberized matte finish that complements the leather rather than contrasting it. An enamel Bridge logo sits flush at the front, adding a refined brand signature without any added bulk. The full leather construction holds its shape through repeated wear, gradually developing a natural contour that sits flat and secure at the waistband. Made in Italy, the attention to craft shows in the clean edges, consistent stitching, and the precise way the buckle seats against the strap. A clean finishing piece that anchors tailored golf trousers or flat-front shorts when the outfit calls for something structured and considered at the waist.

title: Cara Polo Print  / Orchid Bouquet
body_html: The Cara Polo Print is a women's golf polo that brings a seasonal graphic directly into the performance build. Cut in a regular fit, it pairs a TX Jersey front, a stretchable polyester knit with strong moisture management, with a Lightweight Stretch Mesh back that keeps air moving and fabric responsive through every swing. The all-over printed back panel delivers bold pattern contrast against the plain front, while the snap-button collar stand and four-button placket keep the silhouette structured and clean. The Bridge logo sits at the chest as the only branding detail up front, understated against the graphic energy behind. Moisture-wicking and fast-drying throughout, it stays comfortable during a full round even when the sun is up and the pace picks up. A regular fit that moves without pulling, this golf polo works as hard as it reads. OEKO-TEX® certified.

title: Dennis Printed T-shirt / Clay L Fade Pistachio
body_html: The Dennis Printed T-shirt is a men's tennis tee made from Light Textured Jersey Printed, a polyester-spandex blend that moves with the body and recovers cleanly between points. Cut-and-sewn TX Jersey contrast panels frame the seasonal print with structure that reads as part of the design rather than decoration. The crew neckline sits flat, and mesh TX Jersey short sleeves open up airflow when the rally pace builds. The spandex blend gives enough stretch through overhead serves and wide groundstrokes without pulling the fit out of shape. A regular cut moves cleanly through the chest and torso with room to rotate freely on a big serve. The Bridge sits at the chest and back, with a J.LINDEBERG text logo along the side seam for a composed, sport-forward finish. OEKO-TEX® certified, it carries the Swedish design confidence J.LINDEBERG brings to the court.

title: Vent 500 KN Golf Sneaker / Brindle
body_html: The Vent 500 KN Golf Sneaker is a men's golf sneaker built around a ventilated two-color nylon yarn flyknit upper that circulates air across the foot through a full round of walking. An Ortholite insole and EVA midsole work in combination to absorb impact and cushion each step, while the molded TPU outsole features Bridge logo lugs engineered to grip turf and stabilize the stance at address. Spanco lining wraps the interior to reduce friction and add lasting comfort against the foot, and the reflective back counter carries the Bridge logo for a clean, composed finish. The lace closure comes with an extra set included, and the printed J.LINDEBERG wordmark on the sides keeps the branding tight and deliberate. Low-profile enough to move straight from the final hole into the clubhouse without a change.

title: Tranquil Down Jacket / Moonbeam
body_html: The Tranquil Down Jacket is a women's hooded ski down jacket built around a relaxed silhouette and purposeful cold-weather construction. The shell is woven from VX RE:SKI - Shiny Side 2.0 recycled polyester with a PFC-treated water-repellent finish that sheds snow and light moisture on contact, while 800-fill-power duck down sourced through Allied Feather & Down© delivers compressible warmth without bulk. A two-way open-end front zipper lets you vent on the chairlift or seal up fully at the summit, and an adjustable drawcord waist dials in the silhouette when the wind picks up. Integrated Lycra cuffs seal the sleeve at the wrist, two zipped hand pockets and one inner pocket keep essentials close, and the Bridge logo sits cleanly on the left sleeve. The relaxed fit layers easily over a midlayer on a cold powder morning and moves just as well into the lodge when the day is done.

title: Flor LS Polo / Black
body_html: The Flor LS Polo is a slim-fit women's long sleeve golf polo made from 37,5® Soft Touch jersey, a polyester and modal blend with spandex for stretch. The 37,5® technology uses active minerals embedded in the fabric to draw sweat away in the vapor stage before liquid forms, actively regulating body temperature and keeping comfort consistent from the opening tee to the final approach. The jersey wicks moisture and dries fast, staying fresh and holding its shape over a long round without clinging or going sheer. A ribbed collar and button placket keep the silhouette structured and clean, while Bridge branding at the chest and back adds a composed signature. The slim fit follows your frame closely without restricting movement, and the spandex content supports a full, unrestricted rotation through the swing. OEKO-TEX® certified.

body_html: The Enzo Sleeve is a lightweight men's golf sleeve built from Soft Compression™ fabric, a polyester-elastane blend with a super soft handfeel and a subtle sheen. UPF 40+ protection shields your arms through long hours on the course in open sun, while the stretch construction follows every rotation and moves through a full swing without pulling, riding up, or restricting arm speed. The compression fit sits close to the skin and stays in place without constant readjusting, making it easy to layer under a polo when the morning starts cool or pull on midway through the round as the sun gets stronger. The Bridge sits on the left sleeve and the J.LINDEBERG wordmark on the right, keeping the branding refined and quietly intentional. It pairs cleanly with any polo or tee and adds functional UV coverage without adding bulk.

body_html: The Aria Knitted Sweater is a women's crew neck knit sweater made from Tour Merino, sourced from Lanifico di Tollegno, a heritage Italian wool mill with a long history of producing consistent, fine-gauge yarns. The knit construction delivers a soft, even surface, while ribbed trims at the hem and cuffs add structure and keep the silhouette tight and refined at every edge. Merino wool naturally wicks moisture away from the skin and resists odor over time, so the sweater stays comfortable and fresh through a full morning on the course or a day that runs well into the evening without needing a change. The regular fit sits cleanly over a base layer when temperatures are low, or wears alone with its own shape as the day warms. The Bridge embroidered at the chest keeps the J.LINDEBERG identity quiet and considered, letting the quality of the knit carry the look.

title: Aeris Beanie / Purple Heather
body_html: The Aeris Beanie is a rib-knit hat knitted from recycled polyester, arriving in the season's key colorways. The rib construction gives the hat a snug, flexible fit that holds its shape without slipping or bunching across the day, while a pompon in matching shell yarn adds a considered finishing detail at the crown. Soft against bare skin for a synthetic knit, the recycled polyester yarn stays comfortable through long hours in the cold. The Bridge logo sits embroidered on the fold, close and composed. Unisex in proportion and offered in one size, it layers cleanly under a jacket hood or stands on its own, from a cold afternoon walk through the city to a dinner after a long day on the mountain.

title: Creek Down Vest / Black
body_html: The Creek Down Vest is a men's vest built from a shiny VX RE:SKI recycled polyester shell with a PFC-treated water-repellent finish that handles light rain and cold morning air. The removable, drawcord-adjustable hood seals out wind when the temperature drops, while the two-way open-end zip and adjustable hem let you dial in fit and airflow on the go. Two zippered hand pockets and one inner pocket keep essentials secure. The relaxed cut layers comfortably over a midlayer, sitting as naturally on a city commute in January as it does heading into the mountains for a weekend. The shiny shell brings a sport-forward edge, and the Bridge at the chest finishes it with quiet, considered detail.

Elastic endings at the armholes and bottom hem keep the vest in place through a backswing or a quick walk to the next tee, while the two-way open-end zipper and two zip hand pockets add practical ease. The regular fit skims rather than clings, leaving enough room to layer over a collared shirt when temperatures drop or to wear on its own into a Friday dinner. Swedish design, Italian yarn, one piece that earns its place across both.

title: Travers Cap / Set Sail
body_html: The Travers Cap is a six-panel golf cap built from stretch twill, shaped to hold its structure and sit clean from the first shot to the last. Crown ventilation holes cut into the panel let heat out when sun and pace combine, keeping things comfortable across a full round. The cotton-spandex shell blend conforms to the head without pressure and recovers its shape whether stowed in the bag between nines or back in rotation. A stretchable sweatband adjusts to different head sizes and stays flat through the swing without folding or riding. An embroidered graphic anchors the front panel, and J.LINDEBERG stitching runs across the back. Available in unisex sizing in 56 and 58, cut to sit low and stay put through eighteen holes.

title: Leya Sleeveless Top / Purple Heather
body_html: The Leya Sleeveless Top is a women's sleeveless golf polo built for warm-weather rounds, made from TX Jersey with four-way stretch that moves with every rotation and never pulls at the seams. Mesh side panels add targeted ventilation at key heat zones, keeping air circulating and body temperature steady through long hours on the course. The rib collar and placket carry J.LINDEBERG text jacquard artwork in a contrast tone, a considered detail that adds definition without breaking the clean, sport-forward silhouette. Moisture-wicking and fast-drying construction pulls sweat away from the skin so the top stays fresh even when the sun is at its peak. The regular fit sits easy across the shoulders and through the torso, giving full freedom of arm movement on every swing. OEKO-TEX® certified.

title: Selena Full Zip Mid Layer / Moonbeam
body_html: The Selena Full Zip Mid Layer delivers clean lines and all-day performance. Its smooth stretch fabric and brushed interior create a comfortable, close fit that layers easily under vests and jackets. A two-way front zipper, secure side pockets, and signature silicone branding elevate the design, giving it a sleek, athletic look. With moisture-wicking and fast-drying properties, this piece keeps you dry and ready to move from course to café without missing a beat.

title: Danaya Printed Top / Clay Pistachio L
body_html: The Danaya Printed Top is a sleeveless tennis top built in a slim silhouette that reads graphic from the baseline and moves without restriction. Crafted from Feather Weight Light jersey, it sits close to the body without gripping, while mesh side panels cut from a polyester-spandex blend open up ventilation at the sides and allow full arm movement through every serve and groundstroke. Contrast binding frames the crew neck and armholes with a clean, structured finish. Moisture-wicking and fast-drying properties keep the fabric light and dry as rallies push into the third set on a warm afternoon. A seasonal print spans front and back, with the Bridge appearing at center front and center back for a signature J.LINDEBERG detail that carries through from warm-up to match point. OEKO-TEX® certified.

title: Dennis Printed T-shirt / Clay L Fade Purple Heather
body_html: The Dennis Printed T-shirt is a men's tennis tee made from Light Textured Jersey Printed, a polyester-spandex blend that moves with the body and recovers cleanly between points. Cut-and-sewn TX Jersey contrast panels frame the seasonal print with structure that reads as part of the design rather than decoration. The crew neckline sits flat, and mesh TX Jersey short sleeves open up airflow when the rally pace builds. The spandex blend gives enough stretch through overhead serves and wide groundstrokes without pulling the fit out of shape. A regular cut moves cleanly through the chest and torso with room to rotate freely on a big serve. The Bridge sits at the chest and back, with a J.LINDEBERG text logo along the side seam for a composed, sport-forward finish. OEKO-TEX® certified, it carries the Swedish design confidence J.LINDEBERG brings to the court.

title: Leroy T-shirt / White
body_html: The Leroy T-shirt is a men's short-sleeve tennis t-shirt made from open-knit Dry Mesh jersey, a polyester-spandex blend with a structure that circulates air through the fabric and moves sweat away from the skin quickly. Elastic Bridge stripes run down each side seam, adding a clean structural line without bulk or extra weight. A text logo sits on the sleeve with no extra noise. The flat crew neck keeps the collar unobtrusive, and the regular fit allows room through the shoulders to serve, rotate, and reach wide without restriction. Fast-drying construction keeps the fabric feeling fresh from warm-up through a tiebreak third set, and OEKO-TEX® certification confirms the materials have been tested against harmful substances. J.LINDEBERG sport design built to perform from first point to last.
